workflow: q3news_20261012 (Qwen3-8B repeat of the S1 news existence test)
binding_spec: results/method_search_20261011/RANKED.md section 4 (S0, smoke, S1) and section 6 (G_S1)

repeat_of.stage: S1 of results/newsagent_20261011 with Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B (K1 fired: E1 mu +0.05, E1 ln sigma -0.00)

flags_changed_vs_S1_server.tool_call_parser: hermes (S1: qwen3_coder; Qwen3-8B writes JSON tool calls)
flags_changed_vs_S1_server.generation_config: vllm (keeps S1's effective sampling: Qwen3-8B's generation_config.json would add top_k 20 to every request)

server.flags_unchanged: --reasoning-parser qwen3, --max-num-seqs 128, --enable-lora --max-lora-rank 16 --max-loras 4, prefix caching on, default attention backend, seed 0

system_sentence_replaced.old:
Each user message gives you one trading day's information, point-in-time: nothing
in it is dated on or after that day's close except the day's own OHLCV bar.
system_sentence_replaced.new:
Each user message gives you one trading day's information, point-in-time: nothing
in it is dated on or after that day's close except the day's own OHLCV bar and company
news published before 09:00 New York time on the next trading day, before that session opens.

harness_changes: 1. news cutoff: prompt block and news tools both cut at D(t) = 09:00 ET of the next trading day (was 00:00 of t for the prompt block and 23:59 of t for the tools); start of each look-back unchanged; item times are the corrected publication times (repro.newsagent.timefix)

2. news tools get_news / get_news_stats default to the stock's own ticker instead of the hard-coded 'AAPL' (without this the only_ticker filter returns almost nothing for the 95 non-Apple stocks); identical in all arms

3. bars (prompt and bar tools) are shown at the decision day's price level: splits and other non-dividend corporate actions after the day are undone (repro.newsagent.corpactions); dividends after the day are not undone (level shortfall at most 3.1%, median 0.4%); identical in all arms

4. system prompt: one sentence replaced, identically in every arm (system_sentence_replaced), because news after the close is shown and the original sentence says nothing is dated on or after the close except the bar (review option b, sentence only; builder default, see lead_decisions)
unchanged: orders fill at close t (tool_traj.day_step), while the agent decides with news up to 09:00 of t+1: every trading-based quantity of this testbed (fills, book, exposure, P&L, the memory and lessons tools' trade records, any risk or Kelly guard) carries a look-ahead of up to 17 h and is NOT a valid metric; S1 uses only the submitted sigma and mu
forecast target: 5 trading days from close t

pool.definition:
S0: pre-registered samples for the smoke test and S1, and the memorisation-probe plan. CPU only, no model query.

BUILD v2 (review fixes): s1_spec_v2.json, smoke_spec_v2.json and memprobe_spec_v2.json SUPERSEDE the first registration
(s1_spec.json, smoke_spec.json, memprobe_spec.json, never used for any model query), because the v1 caches served items of five
news sources before they were published (Finnhub times read as true UTC) and showed CRWD prices at a quarter of their real level.
The pool is recomputed on the v2 caches (corrected times, point-in-time levels, ca_ok) and the samples are re-drawn with the same
seed and algorithm.

Eligible pool (S1 and smoke): ticker-days of results/newsagent_20261011/data/ticker_days.parquet (repro.newsagent.eligibility) with
  t in [FREEZE_START = 2026-03-03, TEST_END = 2026-09-17]   (RCF/P2 test split, after the documented weight freeze of Qwen3.5-9B:
                                                             Hugging Face repository created 2026-02-27, last modified 2026-03-02)
  anchors_ok, r5_ok, cov_ok, ca_ok, and MIXED: >= 1 F and >= 1 P item in the decision-time prompt block of t,
  a finite rational prior at close t (RCF build_events.price_frame on the stratos panel) and R5 defined on consecutive bars.
Outcomes are attached for the later analysis; the selection never reads them.
pool.note: FREEZE_START = 2026-03-03 (first trading day after Qwen3.5-9B's weights were frozen) is kept so that the Qwen3-8B sample equals S1's all-months registration; for Qwen3-8B it is not binding (released 2025-04-29).

lead_decisions.source: the workflow task of q3news_20261012 (lead's goal unchanged: a new method that makes the model react by the right amount; this workflow repeats the S1 existence test with Qwen3-8B and runs reaction-size training only if over-reaction is measurable)
lead_decisions.model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, thinking on, served by our vLLM server on GPU0 (:18572); only the model changes against S1
lead_decisions.memorisation_rule: REPORT-ONLY: the registered 50-event no-context probe is run at the smoke stage and reported; no month is dropped (the model was released 2025-04-29, before every news month). The S1 sample spans all 7 test months with >= 120 dates, as RANKED.md section 4 originally specified.
lead_decisions.system_prompt: as S1: option (b), the one false sentence replaced identically in every arm; fills stay at close t and every trading-based metric is invalid
lead_decisions.test_split: as S1: DATE split (t >= 2026-03-03 here); held-out-ticker days reported as a secondary set
lead_decisions.seeds: as S1: FULL and NO_NEWS use independent seeds (offsets 101 and 151)

cutoff_note: Qwen3-8B was released on 2025-04-29 (Hugging Face repository Qwen/Qwen3-8B; local weights 0_model_server/models/Qwen3-8B, revision b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218, shard sha256 in 0_model_server/models/Qwen3-8B.local_sha256.txt). Its weights therefore cannot contain events after 2025-04-29. Every news month of the testbed (2025-10 .. 2026-09) and every decision day of this sample (2026-03-03 .. 2026-09-17) is after that date.

selection.algorithm:
(seed 20261011): the pool sorted by (t, ticker) is permuted with numpy default_rng(20261011) -> 'order' (stored; it is
also the reserve list). Pass A takes days with a has_move P item, pass B takes any day, until 125 and then 250 days in total; both
passes respect <= 4 days per ticker and run in rounds with a per-date cap of 1, 2, 3, ... days (round r admits a day only if its
date has < r selected days), which spreads the sample over dates. Months excluded later (if ever) are removed from the pool before
the same procedure is re-run (select()).

anchor.days: t-2 and t-1 (the two previous market days)

sessions.branch_state: every branch starts from the SAVED anchor state (book, decisions, toolbox memory and notes), reloaded from disk

readouts.resampling: test-split days (RCF/P2 split by date: t >= 2026-02-01; here t >= 2026-03-03), 2,000 stock-bootstrap and 2,000 date-cluster resamples, percentile 95% intervals
readouts.session_values: per session, from the LAST submit_decision: ln sigma = ln(max(expected_vol_pct, 0.05)); mu = the submitted expected_return_pct parsed with tool_traj.num from submitted_raw.expected_return_pct, MISSING when absent or not numeric (NOT the harness's parsed['mu'], which turns a missing value into 0). A session without a usable sigma is invalid and left out of the means. Reported per arm: validity, missing-mu rate.
readouts.invalid_sessions: E1: session index k of FULL and NO_NEWS forms the k-th pair; if FULL_k or NO_NEWS_k is invalid (or, for the mu readouts, has a missing mu) pair k is dropped from both arms; a half (k in {0,1} or {2,3}) with no remaining pair drops the day from E1. E2-E4: means over the valid sessions of each arm (a day needs >= 1 valid session in each arm). Every readout is also reported on the days whose 4 FULL and 4 NO_NEWS sessions are all valid; per arm the counts of invalid sessions, turns cut at the 2,048-token limit, context-length (4xx) failures by reason, and the largest prompt token count are reported.
readouts.E1: reliability of the news component: correlation across days between the two half-sample components Delta_h = mean(FULL_h) - mean(NO_NEWS_h), h in {sessions 1-2, sessions 3-4} (session index k = branch k of the arm; FULL and NO_NEWS use INDEPENDENT seeds, offsets 101 and 151); for mu and for ln sigma
readouts.E2: sigma news-day excess V = mean(Delta ln sigma) - mean(realised uplift), Delta ln sigma = mean(FULL 1-4) - mean(NO_NEWS 1-4), realised uplift = ln|R5 - m| - lsig - kappa0 as in P2 (R5 = 100 ln(C[t+5]/C[t]); m, lsig = rational prior at close t; kappa0 = mean of ln|R5 - m| - lsig over the covered no-news TRAIN-split stock-days of results/rcf_20261011/data/nonevent_days.parquet, the P2 constant). Single-turn reference: -0.231 [-0.341, -0.122]
readouts.E3: mu news slope: MZ slope of (R5 - mean NO_NEWS) on Delta mu, by split-half instrumental variables (half-1 component instrumented by half-2, and the reverse, averaged). Single-turn references: priced -0.24, fresh +0.73
readouts.E4: reaction size: mean |Delta mu| (single-turn: 0.64 to 0.71 pp)
readouts.E6: noise vs temperature: between-session sd of ln sigma at T = 0.6 vs 1.0; QLIKE and log score of one T = 0.6 session vs the mean of two T = 1.0 sessions
readouts.secondary_overnight_gap: report-only, never part of K1. Fresh items can restate after-hours or premarket moves, which reveal part of R5's overnight gap. E2b / E3b: E2 and E3 with R5_trd = 100 ln(C[t+5]/O[t+1]) (from the t+1 open, as in RCF) in place of R5 (m and lsig unchanged; kappa0 recomputed with R5_trd on the same no-news train days). E2c / E3c: E2 and E3 on the days on which no FULL session was shown a fresh (F) item with has_move. Both with the same resampling.
readouts.K1: Kill (both picks stop) if either holds: (a) no reliable news signal: E1 < 0.2 for both mu and ln sigma; (b) no over-reaction: E2's interval includes 0 under either bootstrap, AND E3's upper bound is >= 1 under either bootstrap
readouts.G_S1: Flag: the trace restates, to within +/- 0.05 pp, a percent figure that appears in a P item with has_move. Within a decision, flagged FULL sessions have mu deviation signed toward the move direction > 0, or ln sigma deviation > 0; stock-bootstrap interval excluding 0, clustered by day, on >= 60 days where the flag varies. A placebo flag (the trace restates a non-move percent figure from the same items) shows no such effect. Also report lambda-hat for the flag-weighted version with an intercept; the point estimate must be > 0. (CPU, 0 GPU-h, on S1 traces; kill pick 2 if not met)
readouts.G_S1_visible_text: Operational rule (build v2): the move figures and the placebo figures are taken ONLY from text the session actually saw: the prompt block's headlines (the block shows headlines only) and the verbatim tool 'result' strings saved in the trace (get_news shows 300 characters of a summary, search_news 200, inside a 2,500-character output). A figure that is only in the cached item but was never displayed does not count. Before G_S1 is run, the number of days on which the flag varies across the 4 FULL sessions is reported; if it is below 60, G_S1 cannot pass (reported as 'not testable', which kills pick 2 under the spec's own rule).
readouts.trading_metrics: NOT valid in this testbed: orders fill at close t while the agent decides with news up to 09:00 of t+1
readouts.item_classes: F / P / S per session from the saved served-item logs (repro/newsagent/classes.py), never shown to the agent
